{{Quote|Rosh, I'm sending you to the remains of the planet Byss. It's very remote, so I doubt the Cult has been there. Don't stay too long; the Imperial Remnant may still be operating in the area.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Rosh Penin]]|<ref name="Jedi Academy" />}}
The '''First Mission to Byss''' was carried out by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Rosh Penin]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], for the [[New Jedi Order]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] assigned Rosh to investigate the remains of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], and determine whether the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] had been there. Skywalker also suspected that the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] may still be operating there.

==Prelude==
After Luke Skywalker learned that [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]] [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into his records, which contained a list of places with a strong [[The Force/Legends|Force]] connection, he dispatched several Jedi to the locations mentioned in his diary.<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

==The mission==
Rosh was assigned to Byss, but never returned or made contact. After some time, [[Kyle Katarn]] decided to look for him on the planet's remains, and later with [[Jaden Korr]] [[Mission to Byss (Kyle Katarn)|to investigate]] since Penin's mission was never completed.<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

==Aftermath==
During that time, Rosh Penin fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Jedi Academy" />
